steps.caption: Open Settings from the home board
Trash list loaded (demo world seeds five archived sessions)

expect.label: the first archived session, the one [r]estore will act on

steps.caption: An archived session is selected and restorable

scenes.title: the in-flight restore label spells its ellipsis as U+2026 and still carries live progress

The first progress frame off the resurrect stream reaches the TUI

expect.label: BOS-1087: the spinner label renders the ellipsis CHARACTER (U+2026), not three full stops — this is the token the sweep converged
BOS-984, still holding: a live progress line from the streaming resurrect, appended to the spinner label

steps.caption: Two properties in one frame. The marker is now a single ellipsis character, and the label still appends live progress rather than sitting as a bare spinner until the client deadline fires. A screen that regressed either one fails here.

steps.caption: Terminal SessionResurrected frame received — the app routes into the chat picker for the restored session, so the spinner is gone rather than hanging
Hold the settled screen so the capture records the destination rather than ending mid-restore

expect.label: the chat picker's action bar — reachable only once the restore SETTLED, so this is the proof the stream terminated cleanly
the restored session is the one now open

steps.caption: The stream ended on its terminal frame and the session is live, so the ellipsis assertion in scene 2 was made against a real in-flight restore rather than a wedged screen.
